feature: Managed network spec and boot restoration
assessment: Deterministic link/rule/shaping/nft/sysctl renders and ordered systemd restore. Add generations, recovery journal and verified last-boot results; multi-file persistence is not crash-atomic.
Snapshots old files, writes spec last, uses an independent bounded context and terminates host-command descendants. Collect and expose every failed undo step.
Kernel reply-path checks, ordinary/Tailscale-marked/IPv6 anchors and recognizable SSH loopback-tunnel attribution. Add independent timed confirmation and application/transport verification.
Managed/kernel/provider/Docker/Tailscale distinction; protected parents, bridges, addresses, peers and dependent rules. Add observed-state drift and adoption plans.

feature: Backend capabilities, destructive gates, audit and secrets
assessment: Admin mutation gates, restricted VPN/process data and diagnostics, audited no-store secret exports. Extend role precision without weakening backend authorization.
Tool/package hints, systemd reachability and IPv6 state. Add functional feature probes and kernel/NIC/provider constraints beside each operation.
Addresses, uplink, gateway, client path and persistence context. Show both forwarding families and distinguish NIC source from provider public/NAT identity.
Clickable owned-resource diagram and live traffic wires. Add flow-backed edges and effective paths; this is not external-switch discovery.
Two-second figures and fifteen-minute ring. Expose observation age and drill from a chart into its underlying resource.
Actionable destinations for local issues and capacity. Add incident history/correlation and distinguish partial failed observations from absence.
Main page reads preserve data with a stale/retry warning. Apply the same contract to subsidiary polls and per-namespace/per-family reads.
Kind/role/owner, state, addresses, MAC, MTU, parent/master, queue, speed and rates. Add driver/offload/link-error detail where meaningful.
Engine inventory/PID/iflink joins avoid repeated inspection subprocesses. Explicitly flag incomplete/unreadable Docker joins.
Persistent owned bridges, STP and guarded membership. Add VLAN filtering/FDB/snooping and combined migration previews.
Parent/ID/name/address validation and persistence. Add manager-backed profiles and tagged/untagged policy workflow.
VNI, endpoints/parent/group/UDP configuration with validation. Multicast group configuration is API-only. Add underlay readiness, FDB/remote-set management and later EVPN.
Real typed family/endpoint creation, key/TTL support in API and persistence. Add missing advanced UI fields and endpoint/liveness checks; these tunnels are not encrypted.
Typed creation, addressing, state and owned removal. Join them into routing/service recipes rather than adding unrelated complexity.
Bridge/private/vepa/passthru, including guarded passthru. Explain host isolation and provider MAC restrictions; verify supported connectivity.
Validated names/namespace ownership, peer lifecycle and dependency checks. Add namespace-specific inspection and target handoffs.

feature: Device up/down, MTU and bridge edits
assessment: Strong path/address/parent guards; foreign-object edits report runtime-only persistence. Add native owner profile editing and independent recovery.
Managed ownership, address validation and client-source protection. No complete DHCP/SLAAC/static-uplink provisioning transaction.
Create/remove and bounded container reads with partial-failure recovery. Expose per-item failures and add namespace routes/DNS/tools rather than showing failed reads as empty.
Table names, owners, metrics, preferred sources and multipath inspection; local table is counted separately. Add event/history and target filtering.
Persistent family/table/device/gateway/source/metric validation and guarded apply. Managed routes have one next hop; add ECMP and edit plans later.
Typed discard routes and guarded deletion. Preview the destinations/services affected before applying.
Prefix/interface/mark selectors, lookup/discard, family-aware add/delete/rollback/boot. Add effective-match preview and supported UID/TOS/goto/VRF extensions.
Checks live and owned priorities; reserved managed range and kernel/Tailscale table protections. Keep this safety when adding richer rules.
Reply, source-selected reply and internet-anchor checks with rollback. Finite anchors do not prove every app or hostname/roaming VPN endpoint.
Docker/NAT/VPN dependencies, fail-closed unreadable inventory, RA and protection-reset handling. Explain conservative Docker IPv4 counts and add measured forwarding health.
Family/state/prefix/message/uptime parsing, including older output. No BGP policy configuration, route browser, OSPF or dynamic failover controller.
Omits IPv6 policy rules and infers the highlighted client rule. This limits the visualization; backend IPv6 policy rules are implemented.
Editable features and read-only reasons are explicit. Select by actual owner/activity as well as binary presence, and inspect effective interface zones.
Protocol/source/ports, profiles, comments and ordered UFW placement with guards; destination-address matching is API-only. Add grouped plans, shadowing analysis and stable rule identity.
Existing service-aware control and destructive gating. Add staged verification and timed recovery for loss of access.
UI exposes inbound and UFW outbound defaults; routed defaults use the supported backend API. Show effective per-interface/per-family policy and preserved access.
Capability-aware logging/reset, summaries and interpretable logs. Add per-rule history; firewalld lacks the UFW-style reset operation.
Deliberately read-only without a supported persistent manager. Add a scoped native nftables owner adapter; do not silently take over unrelated rules.
Port/range, IPv4/IPv6 target, arrival interface and local-destination match. Verify from an external source; no health-driven target failover.
Source-network/outgoing-device translation and tunnel-owned exits. No one-to-one NAT/NPTv6 or advanced translation-policy workflow.
Validated ranges and owned lifecycle; managed VPN entries have proper handoffs. Add overlap/conflict and impact preview.
Uses the host's routing to choose and saves a deterministic choice. Reevaluate drift caused by external topology changes, not only gateway edits.

feature: Admission through UFW/Docker and foreign conflict checks
assessment: Reserved connmark admission, Tailscale mark separation, boot/mutation reassertion and known incompatibility refusal. Add supported explicit-rule inspection and per-layer uncertainty.
Expanded rules aggregate by comment. Table replacement resets counts; persist deltas or stable counters and label generation/time.
Table presence plus basic admission/forwarding facts. Verify all required families/chains and distinguish policy installed from reachable.

feature: New-flow packet-rate limits, globally or per source
assessment: Protocol/rate/interval/burst/drop-or-reject and source meters match packets in conntrack's new state; established flows bypass them. Add saturation/impact graphs and service profiles.

Stateful source-keyed ceilings with translated-flow scoping. Packet-rate limits can be global or per-source, but the concurrent-connection ceiling is always per-source. Add capacity/impact evidence and an explicit global ceiling if needed.
Validated merged bounded sets, protected operator and persistence. Add change-impact preview and expiring scoped exceptions.
Aggregated feeds, status/counters and trusted bypass. Explain approximate geography, provenance and collateral impact.
Bounded secure fetch/redirect handling, reserved-range exclusions and overbroad-feed guards. Add feed diffs and adjustable/signed refresh where supported.
Last-good cache and stale-fetch concurrency protection; daily refresh needs JD runtime. Actual missing-cache health can disagree with saved count/error.
Loopback, bounded allowlist networks and saved operator addresses precede drops. Add owner/reason/expiry and revalidation of accumulated addresses.

Established/related return avoids cutting current sessions/outbound replies when lists change. Add separate explicit session-revocation workflow; blocking a new connection does not terminate an existing one.
Closed settings, recommendations, bounds, readback, persistence and weakening gates; loose reverse-path filtering respects tunnels. Show per-interface effective values and workload profiles.
Count/max and local warning thresholds. Add time series, flow-state/source breakdown and evidence for the cause of pressure.
Live/config join, down configured tunnels and foreign read-only ownership, no inventory secrets. Add trends, stale-handshake alerts and endpoint history.
Free name/UDP port/subnet, overlap validation, key/config/service creation and firewall outcome. Add dual-stack allocation, provider-public-endpoint evidence and advanced UI settings.

feature: Key generation, sealed client config, QR/copy/download
assessment: Go keys/PSKs, sealed saved configs, restricted audited exports and correctly scaled QR. Add rotation/one-time expiring enrollment; forgetting a saved config is not revoking its peer.

feature: Device peers and split/full client configuration
assessment: Address allocation, networks/keepalive, live sync and saved export. Add peer editing, expiry, groups and quotas.
Overlap/operator/literal endpoint guards and route cleanup. Add continuous protection for hostname/roaming transports and coordinated remote-site verification.
Owned IPv4 NAT/forwarding integration. Managed addressing and egress remain IPv4; add IPv6 egress and leak acceptance.
Captures `::/0` and explains IPv4-only service to avoid native-path leaks. This is containment, not IPv6 internet access or a client kill switch.
Guarded lifecycle, archived server configuration and reported firewall cleanup. Add restore-from-archive and durable lifecycle/recovery history.
Direct/DERP/health view and narrowly scoped locked advertisements. Policy/route approval remains external; failed frontend route submission loses its draft.
Native/container detection; API exposes users/nodes, while UI shows node status/address/user. No enrollment, key, route-approval, user-lifecycle or policy-management workflow.
Writer/symlink/global/per-link/listener/service inspection. Add a cross-distribution owner adapter rather than treating resolved as universal.
Servers/domains/cache/DNSSEC/DoT visibility. Writes remain global; add supported per-link split-DNS profiles via the native owner.
Six presets, ports/scoped IPv6/TLS names and managed drop-in semantics. Empty lists inherit global defaults rather than explicitly clearing them.
Validated resolved mode and TLS names. Add actual transport/trust/fallback verification; no managed DoH/DoQ server is supplied.
Configuration/support/result counters. Direct comparisons do not cryptographically validate signatures; add trust-chain diagnostic evidence.
Readable baseline, restart, A-or-AAAA/private verification and reported undo failure. One verified name cannot establish every relevant DNS scope; show the verification plan/results.
Marked ownership, foreign byte/mode/symlink preservation and malformed-marker refusal. Add duplicate/conflict preview and local-resolution evidence.

Eight record types, response/question/chain checks, truncated-UDP TCP retry, public preset opt-in and bounded fan-out. Add split-DNS-safe default, encrypted transport/DNSSEC tests and explicit target omissions.
Discovers existing native/container services and management ports. Thin integration: no native query/filter/client/DHCP management or DNS-service provisioner.
Counter/reset handling and fifteen-minute ring. Add richer packet/latency/retransmit context and clear observation age.
SQL buckets, bounded windows/points and retention-disabled handling. Add custom-range UI, quotas, percentiles and incident annotations.
Differences recorded Docker counters; avoids retaining duplicate host veth series. Add all-container drill-down and service/flow/peer attribution.
Bounded cached ss deltas and explicit warm-up. Misses UDP/QUIC and short-lived sockets between polls; no complete historical process accounting.
Useful native queue choices and dashboard-owned rollback. Verify effective parameters and preserve/refuse unknown foreign trees.
CAKE bandwidth or HTB/fair leaf and protected-path minimum. Add traffic classes, DSCP/overhead profiles and measured latency benefit.
Ingress policing with clsact protection. It drops traffic; add managed IFB queueing for download SQM/fairness.
Applies congestion control/default qdisc and reports support. Add workload comparison; flipping BBR is not proof of improved performance.
Inventory and attachments, not a loaded flow observer. Add useful detail UI and an optional budgeted telemetry adapter.

Remote-address summaries with local ports, processes and socket/established counts. Full protocol/remote-port/individual-state detail is discarded by aggregation; unconnected UDP is excluded. Add full tuples, duration/bytes/close events and quality limits.
Shareable filtering and stable rows while new data arrives. Add historical flow selection and cross-layer evidence.

feature: Block a remote address from its connection
assessment: Delegates to guarded persistent firewall rules. Add expiry/reason and an incident handoff rather than only a permanent deny.
Shared streamed jobs and refresh after installation. Follow installation with explicit configured/active/verified status; a package is not a working service.
